svg.title: Rev-A perimeter / Z-level reservation map (front view)
svg.desc: Front view from display; north = -Y, east = +X. Provisional reversible architecture study; not a frozen outline.
svg.text: Rev-A perimeter reservation map - front view from display; north = -Y (up), east = +X (right)
PROVISIONAL / REVERSIBLE architecture study. Reservations are coarse planning volumes, not geometry approvals.
MAIN (M): front gap + MAIN PCB + back zone
REAR (R): lower web + REAR + optics + window
C1 Front gap governed by U8 MAX-F10S (2.7 mm max)
C2 J1 / J1301 / TP13xx / J1501 / J201 / J202 all face the dis
C3 FPC edge-wrap versus case inner radius
C4 Charger contacts rear east, J202 west, harness must avoid
C6 Display FPC fold up to 0.7 mm beyond the 43.9 outline
C7 Wi-Fi reservation extends beyond the Ø46 board
C8 GNSS radiator reservation already holds C1420, C1421, R142
C9 Thick corner mixes design choices with tolerances
X10 SFH4053B and MAX86141 seated heights are unknown (hidden d
X11 Optical-face population dictates pod footprint (single- vs
X12 J1502 face and mated height drive the single-/double-sided
X13 Three (four) conductors must cross from the rear side to F
X14 Three support windows leave a 194-degree unsupported arc o
X15 North-east sector: vent, ALS, SW4, support, TP13xx and BMM
X16 BMM350 exposure to charge current, LED pulses and ferromag
X17 GNSS radiator "all assembly heights" volume overlaps displ
X18 Support windows and battery exit overlap the nominal pack
X19 Two 0603 B.Cu capacitors govern the back zone
X20 Pack growth / compression must never load the optical stac
X21 No ingress / water-resistance target is defined
X22 Several Z items are not in the tool stack
Clock faces: az = degrees clockwise from north; z-levels per architecture.json reservations. Black squares: key MAIN parts from main_height_map.json.
